name: menthol + methyl salicylate 2-ethylbutyrate
uses: Use(s) For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints; associated with simple backache, arthritis, strains, bruises, and sprains.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if •severe burning persists or blistering occurs •condition worsens or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days.
